title: Chapter 2: Atoms, Molecules, and Ions
content:
ሰላም የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች! እንኳን ወደ General Chemistry ምዕራፍ 2 (ክፍል 4) በሰላም መጣችሁ! እኔ ከEthioFresh ቲም ጋር በመሆን ይህንን የትምህርት ኖት ለፈተናችሁ 100% ብቁ በሚያደርግ መልኩ አዘጋጅቼላችኋለሁ። ዛሬ በኬሚስትሪ ውስጥ እጅግ ወሳኝ የሆነውን Chemical Nomenclature (የኬሚካል ውህዶች አሰያየም ህጎች) ከክፍል 2.5 እስከ ምዕራፉ መጨረሻ ድረስ በዝርዝር እናያለን። ዝግጁ? እንጀምር!

2.5. Chemical Nomenclature

Nomenclature, a collection of rules for naming things, is important in science and in many other situations. This module describes an approach that is used to name simple ionic and molecular compounds, such as NaCl, CaCO3, and N2O4. The simplest of these are binary compounds, which are compounds containing only two elements. We will also consider how to name ionic compounds containing polyatomic ions, and a specific, very important class of compounds known as acids. We focus here on inorganic compounds (compounds composed principally of elements other than carbon) following IUPAC guidelines.

👉 Chemical Nomenclature ማለት የኬሚካል ውህዶችን (compounds) በስርዓት ለመሰየም የሚያገለግል የህግ ስብስብ ነው። Binary compounds የሚባሉት ከሁለት አይነት ኤሌመንቶች ብቻ የተሰሩ ውህዶች ናቸው። በዚህ ክፍል የIUPAC ህጎችን በመከተል የኢንኦርጋኒክ (inorganic) ውህዶችን አሰያየም በዝርዝር እንማራለን።

2.5.1. Ionic Compounds

To name an inorganic ionic compound, we consider whether it contains monatomic or polyatomic ions, and whether the metal forms cations of fixed or variable charge.

2.5.1.1. Compounds Containing Only Monatomic Ions

The name of a binary ionic compound containing monatomic ions consists of the name of the cation (the name of the metal) followed by the name of the anion (the name of the nonmetallic element with its ending replaced by the suffix -ide).

Table 2.5: Names of Some Ionic Compounds

FormulaNameFormulaName
NaClsodium chlorideNa2Osodium oxide
KBrpotassium bromideCdScadmium sulfide
CaI2calcium iodideMg3N2magnesium nitride
CsFcesium fluorideCa3P2calcium phosphide
LiCllithium chlorideAl4C3aluminum carbide

👉 ከአንድ አይነት አቶም ለተሰሩ ካታዮን እና አናዮን (Monatomic ions) አሰያየም ህጉ ቀላል ነው፦ በመጀመሪያ የብረቱን (Metal/Cation) ስም እንደወረደ እንጽፋለን፤ በመቀጠል የኖን-ሜታሉን (Anion) ስም መጨረሻ '-ide' በሚል ድህረ-ቃል በመተካት እናጠናቅቃለን።

2.5.1.2. Compounds Containing Polyatomic Ions

Compounds containing polyatomic ions are named similarly to those containing only monatomic ions, i.e., by naming first the cation and then the anion.

Table 2.6: Names of Some Polyatomic Ionic Compounds

FormulaName
KC2H3O2potassium acetate
NaHCO3sodium bicarbonate (or sodium hydrogen carbonate)
Al2(CO3)3aluminum carbonate
NH4Clammonium chloride
CaSO4calcium sulfate
Mg3(PO4)2magnesium phosphate

Chemistry in Everyday Life: Ionic Compounds in Your Cabinets

Table 2.7: Everyday Ionic Compounds

Ionic CompoundUse
NaCl, sodium chlorideordinary table salt
KI, potassium iodideadded to iodized salt for thyroid health
NaF, sodium fluorideingredient in toothpaste
NaHCO3, sodium bicarbonatebaking soda; used in cooking and as antacid
Na2CO3, sodium carbonatewashing soda; used in cleaning agents
NaOCl, sodium hypochloriteactive ingredient in household bleach
CaCO3, calcium carbonateingredient in antacids
Mg(OH)2, magnesium hydroxideingredient in antacids
Al(OH)3, aluminum hydroxideingredient in antacids
NaOH, sodium hydroxidelye; used as drain cleaner
K3PO4, potassium phosphatefood additive (many purposes)
MgSO4, magnesium sulfateEpsom salt; added to purified water

Na2SO3, sodium sulfitepreservative

👉 Polyatomic ions (ከአንድ በላይ አቶሞች በአንድነት የያዙ አይኖች) ሲኖሩም አሰያየሙ ተመሳሳይ ነው፦ የካታዮኑን ስም አስቀድመን የፖሊአቶሚክ አናዮኑን ስም ሳይቀየር እንደወረደ እንጽፋለን (ምሳሌ፦ CaSO4 = calcium sulfate)።

2.5.1.3. Compounds Containing a Metal Ion with a Variable Charge

Most transition metals and some main group metals can form two or more cations with different charges. The charge of the metal ion is specified by a Roman numeral in parentheses after the name of the metal. For example, FeCl2 is iron(II) chloride and FeCl3 is iron(III) chloride.

Out-of-date nomenclature: Uses suffixes -ic for higher charge and -ous for lower charge attached to the Latin stem. For example: FeCl3 = ferric chloride, FeCl2 = ferrous chloride, SnF2 = stannous fluoride, SnF4 = stannic fluoride.

Table 2.8: Some Ionic Compounds with Variably Charged Metal Ions

CompoundName
FeCl2iron(II) chloride
FeCl3iron(III) chloride
Hg2Omercury(I) oxide
HgOmercury(II) oxide
SnF2tin(II) fluoride
SnF4tin(IV) fluoride

👉 ተቀያያሪ ቻርጅ (Variable charge) ያላቸው የትራንዚሽን ሜታል አቶሞች ሲኖሩ የብረቱን ቻርጅ በሮማን ቁጥር (Roman Numeral) በቅንፍ ውስጥ ከብረቱ ስም ቀጥሎ እናስገባለን። የድሮው አሰያየም ስርዓት ደግሞ ለከፍተኛ ቻርጅ '-ic' እንዲሁም ለአነስተኛ ቻርጅ '-ous' ይጠቀማል (ምሳሌ፦ FeCl3 = ferric chloride, FeCl2 = ferrous chloride)።

2.5.1.4. Ionic Hydrates

Ionic compounds that contain water molecules as integral components of their crystals are called hydrates. The formula is written by appending a vertically centered dot, a coefficient representing the number of water molecules, and the formula for water (H2O). The added word begins with a Greek prefix denoting the number of water molecules and ends with "hydrate".

Examples: CuSO4·5H2O (copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate), Na2CO3·10H2O (sodium carbonate decahydrate).

Table 2.9: Nomenclature Prefixes

NumberPrefixNumberPrefix
1mono-6hexa-
2di-7hepta-
3tri-8octa-
4tetra-9nona-
5penta-10deca-

👉 Hydrates ማለት በክሪስታል መዋቅራቸው ውስጥ የውሃ ሞለኪውሎችን የያዙ ውህዶች ናቸው። አሰያየማቸው፦ የአንሃይድረስ (Anhydrous) ውህዱን ስም ጽፈን ከዛ የውሃውን ብዛት በግሪክ ፕሪፊክስ (Prefix) ከ 'hydrate' ጋር እናያይዛለን።

📝 Step-by-Step Worked Solutions: Example 2.11 & Check Your Learning

Example 2.11: Naming Ionic Compounds
(a) Fe2S3: Sulfur has a charge of -2 (3 × -2 = -6). Total positive charge must be +6. 2 Fe ions total +6, so each Fe is +3. Name: iron(III) sulfide
(b) CuSe: Selenium has a charge of -2. Cu must be +2 to balance. Name: copper(II) selenide
(c) GaN: Nitrogen has a charge of -3. Gallium must be +3. Name: gallium(III) nitride
(d) MgSO4·7H2O: MgSO4 is magnesium sulfate, and 7 H2O molecules use the prefix 'hepta-'. Name: magnesium sulfate heptahydrate
(e) Ti2(SO4)3: Sulfate ion (SO4^2-) has -2 charge (3 × -2 = -6). 2 Ti ions total +6, so each Ti is +3. Name: titanium(III) sulfate

Check Your Learning Solutions (Ionic Formulas):
(a) Chromium(III) phosphide: Cr^3+ and P^3- → CrP
(b) Mercury(II) sulfide: Hg^2+ and S^2- → HgS
(c) Manganese(II) phosphate: Mn^2+ and PO4^3- → Charge balancing: 3(Mn^2+) and 2(PO4^3-) → Mn3(PO4)2
(d) Copper(I) oxide: Cu^+ and O^2- → 2(Cu^+) and 1(O^2-) → Cu2O
(e) Iron(III) chloride dihydrate: Fe^3+, 3 Cl^-, and 2 H2O → FeCl3·2H2O

😅 EthioFresh Humor Break:

በፈተና ወቅት Iron(III) chloride እና Iron(II) chloride ተደባልቀውብህ "ስማቸውን በስምምነት Iron X ብለን ብንጠራቸውስ?" ብለህ ለኢንቪጂሌተሩ ብትጠይቅ ዜሮ እንደሚያበላህ አትዘንጋ! ሮማን ኒውመራልን አለመርሳት የFreshman ሕይወት ዋስትና ነው!

2.5.2. Molecular Compounds

Molecular compounds consist of discrete, neutral molecules formed by covalent bonds between nonmetal atoms.

2.5.2.1. Compounds Composed of Two Elements

When two nonmetallic elements form a molecular compound, several combination ratios are often possible (e.g., CO and CO2). Naming rules:
• The name of the more metallic element (farther left and/or bottom of the periodic table) is named first.
• The second element (farther right and/or top) is named with the suffix -ide.
• Greek prefixes (Table 2.9) specify the number of atoms of each element.
• The prefix mono- is usually omitted for the first element.
• When two vowels are adjacent, the 'a' or 'o' in the Greek prefix is usually dropped before 'oxide' (e.g., monoxide, tetroxide, pentoxide).

Table 2.10: Names of Some Molecular Compounds Composed of Two Elements

CompoundNameCompoundName
SO2sulfur dioxideBCl3boron trichloride
SO3sulfur trioxideSF6sulfur hexafluoride
NO2nitrogen dioxidePF5phosphorus pentafluoride
N2O4dinitrogen tetroxideP4O10tetraphosphorus decaoxide
N2O5dinitrogen pentoxideIF7iodine heptafluoride

Common Names: NO is nitrogen monoxide (nitric oxide), N2O is dinitrogen monoxide (nitrous oxide), and H2O is water.

👉 ኮቫለንት (Covalent) ውህዶች ሲሰየሙ የአቶሞቹን ብዛት ለመግለፅ የግሪክ ፕሪፊክስ (mono-, di-, tri-...) እንጠቀማለን። ለመጀመሪያው ኤሌመንት አንድ አቶም ብቻ ከሆነ 'mono-' አይጻፍም። ሁለተኛው ኤሌመንት ሁልጊዜ '-ide' በሚል ድህረ-ቃል ያበቃል። ሁለት ቫወሎች በአንድነት ሲመጡ (ለምሳሌ mono-oxide) 'o' ወይም 'a' ይወገዳል (monoxide)።

📝 Step-by-Step Worked Solutions: Example 2.12 & Check Your Learning

Example 2.12: Naming Covalent Compounds
(a) SF6: 1 sulfur atom, 6 fluorine atoms → sulfur hexafluoride
(b) N2O3: 2 nitrogen atoms, 3 oxygen atoms → dinitrogen trioxide
(c) Cl2O7: 2 chlorine atoms, 7 oxygen atoms → dichlorine heptoxide
(d) P4O6: 4 phosphorus atoms, 6 oxygen atoms → tetraphosphorus hexoxide

Check Your Learning Solutions (Molecular Formulas):
(a) phosphorus pentachloride: 1 P and 5 Cl → PCl5
(b) dinitrogen monoxide: 2 N and 1 O → N2O
(c) iodine heptafluoride: 1 I and 7 F → IF7
(d) carbon tetrachloride: 1 C and 4 Cl → CCl4

2.5.2.2. Binary Acids

Binary acids are compounds containing hydrogen and one other nonmetallic element that release hydrogen ions (H+) when dissolved in water.

Naming Rules for Binary Acids:
• The word "hydrogen" is changed to the prefix hydro-
• The other nonmetallic element name is modified by adding the suffix -ic
• The word "acid" is added as a second word
For example, HCl(g) is hydrogen chloride gas, but when dissolved in water, HCl(aq) is called hydrochloric acid.

Table 2.11: Names of Some Simple Acids

Name of GasName of Acid in Water (aq)
HF(g), hydrogen fluorideHF(aq), hydrofluoric acid
HCl(g), hydrogen chlorideHCl(aq), hydrochloric acid
HBr(g), hydrogen bromideHBr(aq), hydrobromic acid
HI(g), hydrogen iodideHI(aq), hydroiodic acid
H2S(g), hydrogen sulfideH2S(aq), hydrosulfuric acid

👉 በውሃ ውስጥ ሲሟሙ H+ የሚለቁ እና ከሃይድሮጅንና ከአንድ ሌላ ኖን-ሜታል የተሰሩ ውህዶች Binary acids ይባላሉ። ስማቸው 'hydro-' በሚል prefix ተጀምሮ በ '-ic acid' ይጠናቀቃል (ምሳሌ፦ HCl(aq) = Hydrochloric acid)።

2.5.2.3. Oxyacids

Oxyacids are compounds containing hydrogen, oxygen, and at least one other element, and consist of hydrogen combined with a polyatomic oxygen-containing anion.

Rules to name oxyacids:
• Omit "hydrogen".
• Start with the root name of the anion.
• Replace -ate with -ic, or -ite with -ous.
• Add "acid".

Table 2.12: Names of Common Oxyacids

FormulaAnion NameAcid Name
HC2H3O2Acetateacetic acid
HNO3Nitratenitric acid
HNO2Nitritenitrous acid
HClO4Perchlorateperchloric acid
H2CO3Carbonatecarbonic acid
H2SO4Sulfatesulfuric acid
H2SO3Sulfitesulfurous acid
H3PO4Phosphatephosphoric acid

👉 Oxyacids (ሃይድሮጅን፣ ኦክስጅን እና ሌላ ኤሌመንት የያዙ ውህዶች)፦ አናዮኑ በ '-ate' የሚያልቅ ከሆነ ወደ '-ic acid' ይቀየራል፤ በ '-ite' የሚያልቅ ከሆነ ደግሞ ወደ '-ous acid' ይቀየራል። 'hydrogen' የሚለው ቃል ሙሉ በሙሉ ይሰረዛል።

💡 Exam Hint:

ፈተና ላይ በብዛት የሚደጋገሙ ተንኮለኛ ጥያቄዎች፦

1. HCl(g) vs HCl(aq)፦ HCl(g) ማለት hydrogen chloride (ጋዝ) ሲሆን HCl(aq) ደግሞ hydrochloric acid (አሲድ) ነው። በቅንፍ ውስጥ ያለውን (g) እና (aq) ትኩረት መስጠት አትረስት!

2. Oxyacids Mnemonic፦ "I ATE something ICky, and bit into a spITEful dOUSe." ማለትም -ate ወደ -ic acid፣ -ite ደግሞ ወደ -ous acid ይቀየራል። (ምሳሌ፦ Nitrate → Nitric acid, Nitrite → Nitrous acid)።

3. Variable charge ያላቸው ሜታሎች ሲያጋጥሙ የሮማን ቁጥሩ የሚያሳየው የቻርጁን መጠን እንጂ የአቶሙን ብዛት አይደለም!
